footer.copy: UX Content Collective · Technical Content Designer Program · October 2026

dashboard.heading: Welcome to the program
dashboard.subheading: Everything you need for the cohort: ContentLab (the practice product you'll build your content system in), the Playground, your weekly exercises, and reference resources.
dashboard.contentlabDesc: A content system viewer. Your content/foundations files power it. Edit them, run the app, and see your system come to life.
dashboard.playgroundDesc: Build the context an AI assistant would receive from your files, then check copy against your own eval rules.
dashboard.exercisesDesc: Weekly task cards. Each includes prep work, objectives, the exercise brief, and hints.
dashboard.resourcesDesc: Key terms, setup guide, repository map, AI tooling guide, contributing reference, and checklists.

contentlab.heading: ContentLab
contentlab.subheading: Your content/foundations files, rendered as a living system. Edit any file in your fork and the page updates when you save.
contentlab.exampleSubheading: A finished content system for Luma, a fictional team workflow app. Read it to see what done looks like, then write your own.
contentlab.emptyTitle: Select a file to view it.

playground.promptDescription: This is the context an AI assistant would receive from your content system. Guide blocks are removed to save tokens. Turn files on and off to see how each one changes the size of the prompt.
playground.emptyPrompt: Select at least one file to build a prompt.
playground.evalDescription: Check copy against the criteria in content/evals.json. Paste copy from an AI assistant, or write your own.
playground.samplesDescription: Every sample in content/evals.json, run against your criteria. A sample marked expect: fail is meant to be caught.
playground.noCriteria: No criteria yet. Add some to content/evals.json.
